svg.text: Astra | V2 | reference geometry / neutral controls
Blue: wing | Ochre: tail | Dashed green: propeller disc | Red +: CG
Coordinate reconstruction; not a construction drawing. Identical metric scale in all views; x aft, y right, z up.
Declared frame, main-wing braces and gear shown; remaining joints, ribs, pilot and engine solids omitted.
